subject: english
question:
**Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word**:

The speaker's voice had a soothing **bass **quality.

options.text: The fisherman caught a large sea bass.
The bass guitar was out of tune.
They heard bass notes from the jazz club.
He adjusted the bass settings on the stereo.

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"bass"** in the given sentence refers to a low-pitched sound or tone, often associated with music or voice. (गहरी आवाज़ या स्वर) • **Example: **The bass notes of the orchestra resonated throughout the hall. • The homonym of **"bass"** is **"bass"**, which refers to a type of fish. (एक प्रकार की मछली) • **Example: **The fisherman caught a large sea bass during his trip. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2: The bass guitar was out of tune.** (गिटार का गहरा स्वर सही नहीं था) - This refers to the musical instrument, bass guitar, which produces deep tones. • **Example:** The musician adjusted the strings of the bass guitar before the performance. • **Option 3: They heard bass notes from the jazz club.** (जैज़ क्लब से गहरी आवाज़ें सुनाई दीं) - Refers to the low-pitched notes in music. • **Example:** The deep bass notes created a mesmerizing ambiance in the club. • **Option 4: He adjusted the bass settings on the stereo.** (उन्होंने स्टीरियो में बास सेटिंग्स समायोजित कीं) - Refers to the low-frequency sound settings in an audio device. • **Example:** Increasing the bass settings enhanced the overall sound quality of the song. 45:Tad9, The correct answer is **Option 4**.
